notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Update – Bug Fixes

Thanks for all your reports! In this update, we've fixed several annoying issues:
- Fixed a bug with machines – you can now properly insert and remove items
- Fixed an issue where the player couldn't control their character after taking damage or dying
- Fixed a bug that prevented picking up items

notes.title: BOBER CONSTRUCTIONS DEMO NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Hello, builders!
We’re excited to announce that the [b]DEMO[/b] of [i]Bober Constructions[/i] is now live. Step into the role of a beaver-builder and test your skills in constructing walls, repairing roads, and tackling various building challenges!

[h2]What’s in store for you?[/h2]
[*]10 levels packed with challenges for ambitious builders
[*]Creative [i]co-op[/i] gameplay (currently local)
[*]A lighthearted, humorous vibe inspired by games like Overcooked

[h2]Play the DEMO[/h2]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380680/Bober_Constructions_Demo/]Click here to play the Steam DEMO[/url][/b]

If you enjoy our game, please [b]add it to your [i]wishlist[/i][/b]! Your support helps us continue to develop Bober Constructions.

[h2]Join the discussion[/h2]
Share your impressions in the comments and let us know what you’d like to see in future updates. We appreciate all of your ideas and feedback!

[b]Happy building![/b]
